title: New Supercomputer Simulation Sheds Light on Moon’s Origin
summary: A NASA and Durham University supercomputer simulation suggesting the Moon may have formed within hours of a giant impact between Earth and a Mars-sized body. It is one of the highest-resolution giant-impact simulations run.
why: HN commenters link it as a cool visualization whenever Theia and Moon formation come up.

quote.text: the simulation released last year of the hypothesized Earth-Theia moon formation is really cool
